name: Himeno Yuria
source:
After a nude image her dear older sister took of her got leaked into the internet by a retro virus, and due to an unspecified amount of people seeing it, Yuria was decreed to have severely broken the Law Against Sexual Misconduct.

Raised in an ordinary middle-class family, Yuria's parents had a good relationship with her, and she loved them as well. However, they abandoned her right after she got arrested, and left Yuria in a desperate state, leading to her signing a pledge for the transfer procedure to Seiren Gakuen. As a result, her life has gone completely off the rails...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=728431]Getchu[/url]]
